title: Chat message bubbles, timestamps and responsive layout
intent: Give chat messages the messenger-standard presentation: own messages on the right, others on the left, per-message time and day separators, and a tablet/mobile layout that keeps the app usable at 375-1280px.

requirements.title: Message sides, timestamps, day separators, responsive layout
requirements.description: Own messages right / others left with distinct bubble styles; per-message HH:MM from the existing time field; a day marker on the first message of each day; tablet (768-1024) and mobile (<768) layouts for the chat screen with a list<->chat switch on mobile.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-10-19: 'проработай стили — сообщения с разных сторон, дата и время, планшетная и мобильная вёрстка'

constraints: No data-flow changes: time/isMine already reach the messenger mapping; formatting is view-side only.
Mobile list<->chat switching uses CSS classes driven by existing store state (selectedChat) plus a UI-only state — no router changes.
Existing suites stay green; stylelint/eslint clean.
Desktop layout (>=1024) keeps its current geometry apart from the new bubble internals.
